question: Select the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 4.
solution: The correct answer is **attitude**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Attitude:** the way that you think, feel or behave. (सोचने, अनुभव करने का तरीक़ा विशेष; रुख़, अभिवृत्ति, मनोवृत्ति, दृष्टिकोण) • The sentence implies that the first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic point of view. • Thus, the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 4 is **option 3**. Correct Paragraph:__ *Tattooing is a talent that requires a lot of time and (1) __ability__. There are many various kinds and (2) __genres__ tattooing. Tattooing was and still is a means to communicate someone's thoughts or life by permanently (3) __embedding__* *a design of ink and colour into their flesh. The first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic** (4)** __**attitude**__* *and the skill to sketch and create your artwork. Tattooing penmanship is far more (5) _______ than sketching on paper.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Glimpse: **a very quick and not complete view of somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का संक्षिप्‍त और अधूरा दृश्‍य; झाँकी, झलक) • **Drama: **a play for the theatre, radio or television. (नाटक) • **Career: **the period of your life that you spend working. (जीविका और वृत्ति में बिताए समय की अवधि) 46:Tef7, The correct answer is **complicated**.
